## Description and Rationale

I am a former Air traffic controller from Vietnam, now transitioning into data science. I joined this challenge to apply my aviation domain knowledge, strengthen my data-analysis skills, and explore how data-driven solutions can improve air traffic operations.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Vietnam

library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~forename, ~surname,  ~affiliation,
   1L,   "Giang",    "Bui", "Independent"
  )
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
